title: I built a trading bot for prediction markets using Claude Fable 5. Looking for backtesters
author: cherrieshere
selftext:
been working on this for a while and it's done now, running automated and unattended. features:

scans markets across polymarket and kalshi for opportunities

generates trade signals from historical patterns and price movement

automated buy and sell execution, no manual input needed

built in risk management and position sizing per trade

backtesting engine against historical market data

real time alerts on entries and exits

want a few people to backtest it against their own market history and confirm the numbers hold up before I put it out more widely.

if you're interested pm me. there's a small reward for anyone who puts in real testing time.

I am also tired of ppl posting simple "profits" like it means something

comments.author: PlzDontTakeMyAdvice
comments.body: Sorry mate. You can only forward test events. Any sort of backtest would yield false data as whatever system you build would already know the results in real time. Unless you had a way to collect all the data from each website, time stamp it, analyze it, and somehow make quantitative data out of qualitative data. My suggestion is start making as many predictions as possible and seal them shut, only open them when the date you set to open them comes around. Fable 5 is a great data analysis tool, but will lie to you up and down since everything current is already in its training data. Need to find data that it doesn't have yet, which is only possible by making sealed predictions. Good luck!
